note: S14b.2 (P-PROMOTE) the happy path: a FLAT store [v@600(0,1000), h@500(0,600)] (a valid 3-cell partition: left column split by h@500 into two, plus the full-height right cell). promote the LEFT column via the cell-anchor set [1:0:0, 1:0:1] (the two left cells). The block tiles a FILLED rectangle {0,0,600,1000} (sum_area 2*600*500=600000 == bbox 600*1000=600000 → exact_cover; A::valid over the interior is ok), so {ok:true}. The promotions record is {id:1, region:[the anchors], line_set:[the interior h@500 — GEOMETRY not a line-ID, robust pre-S15], coord_map:{0,0,600,1000} the block bbox}. The segments/bindings/off_top are BYTE-UNTOUCHED (promote is a pure LABEL op — it only appends to .promotions). Does NOT assert binding survival (that is O3/S15) — cells are unbound. Post-op cells_rec(derive_nested) sees ONE LEFT cell encapsulating its two child leaves (proven in arrangement/derived_tree_2level).
